candidates.claim: OT-facing access port sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/6 is assigned to VLAN 20 (DMZ) instead of the required OT VLAN 10.
candidates.remediation: Return sw-ot-01 Gi1/0/6 to access VLAN 10 and verify that no DMZ device is attached to this OT-facing port.

candidates.claim: The access VLAN of sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/6 differs from the approved baseline (baseline VLAN 10, current VLAN 20) and is not reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the Gi1/0/6 access VLAN change with the approved baseline and revert it to VLAN 10 unless an approved change record exists.
